Trump's Post-Election Letter to Biden and Election Doubts Emerge

Former President Donald Trump sent a letter to President Joe Biden in 2021 expressing affection, stating, 'I Know How Much You Love the American People.' This emerged alongside reports of Trump questioning the honesty of the election he lost. Democrats expressed skepticism about Trump's willingness to cooperate with them, particularly following his elevation of Stephen Miller.
